summary: The cut is clean, but the hand lift around 11.8 to 12.0 is a fast, unanticipated swing, and the crop cuts the face off at the nose, so the face and the "secret" beat are lost.

faults.what: The hand goes from belly height at 11.76 to above the shoulder at 12.00 in about 7 frames. It starts with no anticipation and has no ease in. The arm swings across the torso like a snap rather than a delicate secret gesture. The measured spike at 11.8 is this start of the swing.
faults.fix: Add a 3 to 4 frame wind-up or pause before the lift. Ease the lift in and out, and settle it beside the face.
